capabilities.target: packaged CLI specification, project Forme config/content, deploy manifests/content stores/target configs, and local package manifests
capabilities.justification: Loads the declarative CLI Builder specification, selected project and deploy inputs, and local file dependencies for builds, deploy, watch mode, and the repository bootstrap helper.

capabilities.target: selected Forme project root excluding generated output, cache, dependency, and VCS trees
capabilities.justification: Coalesces authored project changes into conservative full-pipeline preview rebuilds.
The watch command serves successful in-memory preview artifacts and live-reload events on loopback.

capabilities.target: configured cache and DeployArtifact output directories beneath the project root
capabilities.justification: Implements the explicit forme clean command with containment checks.

capabilities.target: configured project cache, build-to-deploy input, selected filesystem deploy root, and user-selected deterministic report
capabilities.justification: Persists cache entries, materializes explicit deploy inputs, atomically publishes the selected filesystem target, and writes an optional real-deploy report.

capabilities.target: configured project cache, deploy-input staging, filesystem publication transaction paths, and report parents
capabilities.justification: Creates cache shards and the explicitly selected staging/publication/report paths.
Inspects and publishes the explicitly configured GitHub Pages source ref through the reviewed Git Data API boundary.
Reads the sole supported hosted-deploy credential only for a real GitHub Pages publication.

capabilities.target: npm install for local file dependencies
capabilities.justification: The repository-only bootstrap helper installs local file dependencies in deterministic leaf-first order.
Observes interactive and CI termination and propagates cooperative cancellation through builds and deploys.
Prints command summaries and stable machine-coded diagnostics for terminal and CI consumers.

justification: The headless CLI loads project and deploy inputs, creates explicit build/deploy state, publishes only through the selected filesystem or GitHub Pages adapter, handles cooperative process cancellation, and provides the repository bootstrap helper.
